description.zh:
源地址池是否启用：

- true: 启用；
- false：不启用。
description.en:
Specifies whether the origin address pool is enabled. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.
- false: Not enabled.

description.zh: 源地址池ID，可通过调用[ListOriginPools](~~ListOriginPools~~)接口获取。
description.en: The origin address pool ID. You can call the [ListOriginPools](~~ListOriginPools~~) operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 源地址池里添加的源站信息，多个源站使用数组传值。
description.en: The origin server information added to the origin address pool. Use an array to pass multiple origin servers.
The addresses of the origin server, such as www.example.com.

description.zh: 鉴权信息，源站为OSS或者S3等源站需要鉴权时，需要传鉴权相关配置信息。
description.en: The authentication information. This parameter is required when the origin server is OSS, S3, or another origin server that requires authentication.

description.zh:
源站是否启用：

- true: 启用；
- false：不启用。
description.en:
Specifies whether the origin server is enabled. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.
- false: Not enabled.

description.zh: 回源时带的请求头，只支持Host。
description.en: The request header included in back-to-origin requests. Only Host is supported.

description.zh:
回源请求使用的 IP 协议版本：
- round_robin：默认策略，随机轮询 IPv4 或 IPv6 源站
- ipv4_first：优先使用 IPv4 源站
- ipv6_first：优先使用 IPv6 源站
- follow：优先跟随客户端使用的 IP 版本
description.en:
The IP protocol version used for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:
- round_robin: default policy. Randomly polls IPv4 or IPv6 origin servers.
- ipv4_first: preferentially uses IPv4 origin servers.
- ipv6_first: preferentially uses IPv6 origin servers.
- follow: preferentially follows the IP version used by the client.

description.zh: 源站名称，一个源地址下源站名称唯一。
description.en: The origin server name. The name must be unique within an origin address pool.

description.zh:
源站类型：

- ip_domain: ip或域名类型源站；
- OSS：OSS地址源站；
- S3：AWS S3源站。
description.en:
The origin server type. Valid values:

- ip_domain: an IP address or domain name-based origin server.
- OSS: an OSS address-based origin server.
- S3: an AWS S3 origin server.
The weight. The value is an integer from 0 to 100.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the ID.

title.en: Modify a single origin address pool
